issue_context.title: "e2e.test --help" panics due to bad flag-parsing code
issue_context.body:
#### What happened:
I ran `e2e.test --help` and it panicked:

```
> ./_output/bin/e2e.test --help
Usage of ./_output/bin/e2e.test:
  -add_dir_header
    	If true, adds the file directory to the header of the log messages
...
  -gce-zone string
    	GCE zone being used, if applicable
panic: runtime error: invalid memory address or nil pointer dereference
[signal SIGSEGV: segmentation violation code=0x1 addr=0x0 pc=0x1802967]

goroutine 1 [running]:
k8s.io/kubernetes/vendor/k8s.io/component-base/cli/flag.(*StringSlice).String(0xc00399d720, 0x4547c40, 0xc00399d720)
	/home/danw/src/k8s.io/kubernetes/_output/local/go/src/k8s.io/kubernetes/vendor/k8s.io/component-base/cli/flag/string_slice_flag.go:41 +0x27
...
```

#### What you expected to happen:
no panic

#### How to reproduce it (as minimally and precisely as possible):
```
make WHAT=test/e2e/e2e.test
./_output/bin/e2e.test --help
```

#### Anything else we need to know?:
The panic was introduced by #98787. I submitted #99704 as an attempt to fix this, but review led to the realization that there were further bugs and I don't know what the right fix is

cc @DangerOnTheRanger

review_comments:
why does this happen?

i saw the linked PR:
https://github.com/kubernetes/kubernetes/pull/98787/files

and it has https://github.com/kubernetes/kubernetes/pull/98787/files#diff-c017e0c5e68c14cb966137bc87de3d3ab8475dc25f9b5fdb47a2b8174830054fR343

```
flags.Var(cliflag.NewStringSlice(&cloudConfig.Zones), "gce-zones", "The set of zones to use in a multi-zone test instead of querying the cloud provider.")
```

isn't that sufficient for `--help` not to panic?
ok, looks like this change is valid, given we want to append to the cloudConfig.Zones slice.
